title: Fuzzy / Ultralight Axion Dark Matter (Hu, Barkana, Gruzinov)
efc_relevance: DM as ultralight scalar m ∼ 10⁻²² eV with de Broglie wavelength ∼ kpc; suppresses small-scale structure. Orthogonal to EFC; scope-separation note: EFC is gravity-sector, FDM is particle-sector. FDM and EFC can in principle be simultaneously true or simultaneously false.
ledger_action: Logged as particle-sector DM alternative. Scope-separation note in Elevator Pitch.
